parameters.name: CrossAccountRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM role of the account to back up. This parameter is required when you configure cross-account backup by assuming a RAM role.

parameters.name: CrossAccountType
parameters.description:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values:

- **CROSS\_ACCOUNT**: Cross-account backup is configured by assuming a RAM role.

- **CROSS\_ACCOUNT\_BY\_RD**: Cross-account backup is configured based on a resource directory.

parameters.name: CrossAccountUserId
parameters.description: The UID of the account to back up.
